review_text: Steve's Korean BBQ here is a Berkeley institution. Massive portions for under 12 bucks, perfect after a late library session.
Cheap, fast, and the pad see ew is genuinely good. Cash only sometimes so bring a card backup. Gets packed at lunch.
The whole alley is a vibe but hygiene is questionable at some stalls. Stick to the busy ones with high turnover.
Best cheap pizza near campus. A slice and a drink for like 6 dollars. Seating is cramped but the focaccia sandwiches slap.
Good for studying with coffee but the food is overpriced for what it is. Wifi is reliable which is the main draw.
Halal options here are clutch. The gyro stall gives you a mountain of rice and meat for cheap. Student budget approved.
Sushi was kind of warm and the rice was off. For the price you're better off at the dining hall honestly.
Boba spot in the alley has a huge menu and is way cheaper than the chains on Telegraph. Lines move fast.
Cheap burritos the size of your forearm. A super burrito easily feeds you twice. Open late which is the real win.
Convenient when you have 30 minutes between classes but seating is basically nonexistent, you're eating standing up.
